svg.title: Circuit breaker
svg.desc: A circuit breaker stops calling a failing service and fails fast until a trial call shows it has recovered. Trips on a consecutive-failure count (3) rather than a sliding-window failure rate. The open state is shown returning errors; real clients often return a fallback instead. A failed half-open trial would reopen the breaker and restart the cooldown; this loop shows only the successful trial. 1. Closed: calls pass through to the service. 2. Service fails: each failed call is counted. 3. Open: calls fail fast without reaching the service. 4. Half-open: one trial call tests the service. 5. Closed again: the trial succeeded, so traffic resumes.
